public_interface: No public slot/signal/type changes; initialize emits ready only after project/reagent reservation schemas and all saved/hidden identities are protected.
startup_dependency: ProjectsStore.ready and ReagentStore.ready before CalibrationStore.initialize. The module consumes reservation tables without creating/changing catalog schema.

business_contract.project_id: project_base.id stable local key; no display-row or name-derived identity
business_contract.batch_id: reagent_batch_group.id stable key; zero means no batch selected, with no batch reservation
business_contract.reservation_order: own local BEGIN IMMEDIATE serializes same-dataset writers; own worker catalog-reservation BEGIN IMMEDIATE validates identity and commits holds; local record/point commit follows. Two database files are NOT one atomic transaction or a cross-file foreign key.
business_contract.failure_order: while retaining local writer lock, release only catalog holds newly acquired for this failed action, then rollback local transaction. Existing holds, other datasets and QC owner keys are never released.
business_contract.soft_delete: visible=0 retains original record/points and durable project/batch reservations
business_contract.units: Saved concentrationUnit/resultUnit/unitRatio and raw values remain unchanged on update/copy. New records must match current enabled project types/units/ratio. Historical copy still requires enabled project, both Original/Calibration result types and historical unit dictionary rows to exist. No silent conversion or clinical fitting.
business_contract.precision_limit: Calibration raw inputs retain the original maximum 4 decimal places. CalibrationRecord has no newly invented per-result decimal snapshot; QC association resultRefs separately verify their persisted result decimals/ratio snapshot.
business_contract.roles: Original CalibrationStore.canEdit unchanged: authenticated actionReady roles1..5; Guest rejected. No project/reagent/QC permission change.
business_contract.migration: Only known tagged sn100-calibration-local-v3 library may append dataset_uuid/reference_protocol when both keys were absent. Existing rows/points/units are untouched. Partial/invalid identity metadata fails closed; original source preimages are archived separately.
business_contract.reconciliation: Startup scans all records including hidden. Missing/renamed/foreign project/batch or own-dataset orphan holds fails initialization with preserved data/holds. Orphans are never auto-deleted; test demonstrates explicit real ProjectsStore release only after local absence is verified.
